title: Boutique Law Office
description: A growing boutique law firm needed window treatments that conveyed authority and discretion across three floors of glass-fronted offices. Panel tracks in a warm charcoal fabric provide adjustable privacy for client meetings, while a motorized system allows partners to control light levels from a central panel. The installation was completed overnight to avoid disrupting the firm's schedule.
